title: A criterion for proving entropy chaos on path space
summary: A criterion for proving a strong form of propagation of chaos on the path space, known as entropy chaos, for a general interacting diffusion system is proposed. Our analysis focuses on the class of conservative diffusions introduced by Carlen, which are characterized by infinitesimal characteristic pairs, that is, a time-marginal probability density and a current velocity field. A key property of this broad class is that the processes remain diffusions under time-reversal.
